name: createBenefitClearanceHeadInformation
description: Create a new Benefit Clearance Head position and assign an employee to it. Both position name and employee ID are required fields.
taskName: Creating New Benefit Clearance Head Position Record

basic.name: createBenefitClearanceHeadInformation
basic.description: Create a new Benefit Clearance Head position and assign an employee to it. Both position name and employee ID are required fields.

args.name: positionName
args.description: The name of the new Benefit Clearance Head position to create (e.g., 'IT Operations Lead', 'Finance Manager', 'HR Coordinator').

args.name: employeeId
args.description: The employee ID to assign to this position (e.g., '000001', '00000006'). The system will search for this employee and assign them to the new position.

args.name: createWorkflowApproval
args.description: Whether to enable workflow approval for this position. Use 'true' to enable or 'false' to disable. Defaults to false if not provided.
